task_distribution.scope: one deterministic synthetic P-256 recovery-checkpoint positive oracle

public: complete generated positive fixture and synthetic test scalar
known_answer: two independent generated output trees must match byte-for-byte
cryptography and OpenSSL must verify the same frozen signature

tool_access_restrictions: no production imports in independent verifier
no real key, hardware, database, clock, network, runtime, or dispatch

final_output.reason: fixture bytes and receipt are the claim surface

execution_trace.reason: generator and two verifier paths execute locally

side_effects.reason: writes must remain inside the run directory and touch no real key or service

cost.reason: two bounded generator attempts and finite verification

recovery.reason: a failed attempt leaves isolated output and does not overwrite accepted evidence

semantic_reviewers: three local same-provider read-only council roles
uncertainty_method: separate observations, inferences, unsupported claims, and dissent
supersession_policy: retain failed attempt and add a versioned bounded remediation
